verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Mastra Code can resume its most recent thread and can be pointed at a remote database instead of local SQLite. Neither is documented as a way to pick up a task from another device or a browser. Pairing a remote database with thread resume would be a user-built workaround, not a cross-device or browser continuation feature of the product, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As a developer, I can start a task on one device and continue it later from another device or browser
